follow-up time: Through delivery and early neonatal period
finding: In a nationwide Danish cohort, while only 62.5% of fetuses with a normal first-trimester scan in monoamniotic twin pregnancies were born alive, mortality was much lower (3.8%) after 26 weeks among those managed as outpatients.
mod_finding: All live births in the study were delivered by cesarean delivery at a median gestational age of 33 weeks.
gest_age: Median gestational age at delivery for live births was 33 weeks
